arg.name: image
arg.description: The image topic. Should be remapped to the name of the real image topic.

arg.name: use_camera_info
arg.description: Indicates that the camera_info topic should be subscribed to to get the default input_frame_id. Otherwise the frame from the image message will be used.

arg.name: debug_view
arg.description: Specify whether the node displays a window to show edge image

arg.name: queue_size
arg.description: Specigy queue_size of input image subscribers

arg.name: canny_threshold
arg.description: Upper threshold for the internal Canny edge detector.

arg.name: gaussian_blur_size
arg.description: The size of gaussian blur (should be odd number)

arg.name: min_circle_radius
arg.description: The minimum size of the circle, If unknown, put zero as default

arg.name: max_circle_radius
arg.description: The maximum size of the circle, If unknown, put zero as default.
